title: Pick the Branch Value
goal: Make both branches of an if expression return matching integers.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Morning: Control Flow Basics

hints: A line ending in a semicolon returns unit `()`, not an integer.
Both branches must return the exact same type to assign into `result`.
explanation: An `if` expression requires every branch to produce the exact same type. Omitting the semicolon leaves the `i32` value as the branch result. Adding a semicolon converts the expression into a statement and produces `()`, which triggers error `E0308` because the branch types no longer match.
